sources.notes: Gate: no usable file. The free monthly file https://gis.cccounty.us/Downloads/Assessor/Parcels_Public_September2026.zip (42,044,982 bytes, modified 2026-10-02; shapefile of 387,936 parcels) carries only APN, APN check digit and situs components (S_STR_NM, S_STR_SUF, S_STR_NBR, S_FRAC, S_APT_NBR, S_CTY_ABBR, S_ZIP, S_ZIP_EXT): no use code, no values, no owner. Read in full on 2026-11-03. Property characteristics are not posted; contracosta.ca.gov (the Assessor's site) answers 403 to automated clients (Cloudflare challenge, robots.txt included). gis.cccounty.us/robots.txt disallows only /arcgis/* and /portal/*. What would clear the gate: a request to the Assessor (contracosta.ca.gov/assessor) for the secured roll with use codes and its price and terms.
